channel.title: GRAVITY Research Notes
channel.description: The Gravity Report: an independent NBA analytics publication built around GRAVITY, an original player-value model — numbered research notes, registered forecasts, annual audits.

item.title: The GRAVITY Specification (v3) — the full mathematics of the player-value model
item.description: Every equation, weight, shrinkage rule, tier cut, and the complete injury-override table, published as a standalone citable technical document. Five pages, typeset in LaTeX. PDF: papers/spec.pdf

item.title: Research Note No. 2 — The Queta Problem: why he’s a top-50 player, and why 2026-27 proves it
item.description: A prediction paper, revised v2 after external review. GRAVITY ranked Neemias Queta #41; this note attacks the number (an empirical on/off persistence model, a 33-season / 22-player comparables engine with a cutoff-sensitivity table), reports honestly that the harshest discount grazes the claim, and registers the forecast: 75% top-50 by July 2027, falsification criteria on the record. PDF: papers/queta.pdf

item.title: Research Note No. 1 — The Rise and Fall of Ja Morant: a statistical account, 2017–2026
item.description: Seven seasons, one instrument; revised v2 after external review. At the zone level the collapse was 88% shot-making; the three-point crash fits inside its own confidence interval; the free throw improved significantly; and a seven-variation sensitivity appendix shows #140 holds (#112–#147) under every judgment call. PDF: papers/morant.pdf
